# T-1: Normalize test review arrays

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add deterministic normalization for missing top-level test-review findings arrays before schema validation while preserving strict validation for invalid values and malformed items.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 missing blockingFindings and advisoryFindings fields are filled as empty arrays before TEST_REVIEW_RESPONSE_SCHEMA validation.
- R2 invalid JSON, non-object JSON, non-array fields, and malformed item objects still fail validation.
- R3 accepted parser output still feeds the existing TestReviewArtifact counts and verdict behavior.
- R4 the normalization pattern is shared or centralized with the existing spec-review missing-array behavior.

## Implementation Notes
Target `src/flow/commands/review.js` around parseTestReviewJsonOutput and normalizeSpecReviewResponseShape. Keep the helper generic for fixed top-level array fields; do not normalize nested item fields.

## Test Strategy
Add helper or parser-level assertions through existing exported review functions; use spec-local tests for R1-R4 behavior and unit regression for parseTestReviewFindings.
